name: taqyeem-psychiatry
description: Taqyeem — bilingual psychiatry residency assessment, with a Worker API and SQL database.

scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run check:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:setup:remote: npm run check:config && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=server/setup/psychiatry.sql
scripts.deploy:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:runtime && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run check:config && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy
